async def act(page):
    # Search for the 'metaseq' project using the searchbox
    search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search or jump to…")
    await search_box.fill("metaseq")
    await search_box.press("Enter")
    # Wait for the search results to load; assuming it navigates to a search page or updates the list
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After search, the project link should be clickable; look for a link with name containing 'metaseq'
    # Using exact=False for substring match as per the example
    project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="metaseq", exact=False)
    await project_link.click()
    # After clicking, the page should navigate to the project details
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
